inlines.v: HEARSE, noun hers. [See Herse.] A temporary monument set over a grave. 1. The case or place in which a corpse is deposited. 2. A carriage for conveying the dead to the grave. [See Herse.] 3. A hind in the second year of her age. HEARSE, verb transitive hers. To inclose in a hearse
